name: io.github.agentvalet/mcp-server
title: AgentValet
description: Governed credential broker — lets AI agents call approved SaaS platforms through a policy-checked, human-approval, fully-audited proxy. The agent never holds a raw token.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_ID
environmentVariables.description: Agent ID from AgentValet registration (agt_...). Required to make platform calls; tool discovery works without it.

environmentVariables.name: PROXY_URL
environmentVariables.description: AgentValet proxy base URL. Leave as default unless self-hosting.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the agent's RS256 PKCS#8 PEM private key file. Provide exactly one of AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH, AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY, or AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY_B64.

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: RS256 PKCS#8 private key as raw or \n-escaped PEM (alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH).

environmentVariables.name: AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY_B64
environmentVariables.description: Base64-encoded RS256 PKCS#8 PEM (alternative to AGENT_PRIVATE_KEY_PATH).
